items.title: Witch Baking Star Cookies
items.alt: A smiling witch holds a baking tray with five star-shaped cookies.
items.description: A smiling witch in an oven apron carries a small baking tray with five clearly spaced star-shaped cookies, using two oven mitts. Use this illustration for personal crafts and seasonal recipe journals.

items.title: Witch Reading to a Frog
items.alt: A bespectacled witch reads a book to a little frog seated on a cushion.
items.description: A bespectacled witch sits on a small stool with a closed-back open book on her knees, while a little frog listens on a low cushion at her feet. Use this illustration for personal crafts and classroom reading corners.
